content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Percussionist – Punjabi Folk Dhol (Male): Passed 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent with 50% marks (relaxed for SC/ST/Ex-Serviceman/higher qualification) OR Matriculation plus ITI/Act Apprenticeship; Degree/Diploma/Certificate in respective discipline from Government Recognized Institute For Theatre/ Drama Artist (Male/Female): Passed 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent with 50% marks (relaxed for SC/ST/Ex-Serviceman/higher qualification) OR Matriculation plus ITI/Act Apprenticeship; Degree/Diploma/Certificate in respective discipline from Government Recognized Institute

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RCF Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in RCF Cultural Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Cultural Quota Posts in Rail Coach Factory Kapurthala (RCF) Recruitment 2026. These posts include Percussionist and Theatre/Drama Artist roles.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for the RCF Cultural Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: The post names are Percussionist – Punjabi Folk Dhol (Male) and Theatre/ Drama Artist (Male/Female). Each post has one vacancy, making a total of two positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RCF Cultural Quota Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the application form for RCF Cultural Quota Posts Recruitment 2026 is 18 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach by this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RCF Cultural Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the RCF Cultural Quota Posts must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RCF Cultural Quota Posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Women candidates. This fee is non-refundable and must be paid as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have passed 12th or equivalent with 50% marks (relaxations apply) and possess a Degree/Diploma/Certificate in the respective cultural discipline from a Government Recognized Institute.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the RCF Cultural Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline. Download the application form from the official website, fill it carefully, attach required documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Cultural Quota Posts in RCF?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for Cultural Quota Posts will receive a salary at Level-2, which includes a Grade Pay of 1900. This is a stable government job with good benefits.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for RCF Cultural Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test (50 Marks), Practical Demonstration (35 Marks), Testimonial/Prize Assessment (15 Marks), followed by Document Verification. Performance in all stages is crucial.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for RCF Cultural Quota Posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Cultural Quota Posts is Kapurthala, Punjab, with the Rail Coach Factory (RCF) being the recruiting organization. It's a full-time government position.
